description.en: Pick where a session runs before it starts — Local, OCI container or remote SSH host: commands, file I/O and skills land on the chosen environment, with live CPU / memory / disk monitoring.
description.zh: 启动会话前选择 Local / OCI 容器 / SSH 远端运行环境：命令、文件读写与 Skill 都落到所选环境，并实时监测 CPU、内存与磁盘负载。
